svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/antenna/ - Antenna behind a measured cable
When it is seen: like 14, but for the antenna measurement.
What to draw: like image 5 (recognisable antenna, far from metal and people), with in between
the measured cable (long and wavy) and the calibration plane before the cable, as in 14.
Details: same setup as 14, so that it is seen that only the device changes.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
